**Prior Degrees:** BSc, mechanical engineering, 2018

I'm Iván González, a mechanical engineer from Chile who joined the CCWJ in January 2020 thanks to the ELAP program that funds the internship. My intention is to merge my background as a mechanical engineer with novel tools of data analysis, I have been doing that in the field of realiability and mantainability of physical assets and now I entered the welding filed thanks to the CCWJ. I'm also passionate about music, which I love playing, listening and exploring, besides that, I like photography which helps me to see the world in another pair of eyes.
